reviews.t: Orange nails for the next two years......
reviews.x: Package arrived 2 days earlier than expected!  All are in good shape and free of damage.  Great price as well.....BUT.... I was expecting 10 piece "random", which I would assume I would get a few different colors......BUT received 3 bright orange (exactly the same color), 2 light orange (exactly the same color), 2 orange with a pink tint, 1 darker pink with orange tint, 1 light pink and 1 deep purple.  I do like the color orange......but come on 8 polishes that are in the orange shade!  One can

This product had broken brushes, the varnish had been thinned, some of the bottles had varnish drops on the outside, showing they had been opened. The colors were not in a varied range, but different shades of the same color- i.e., nearly all peach! THEN, I FIND OUT THAT AMAZON DOESNT ALLOW THE RETURN, BECAUSE IT IS FLAMABLE. Obviously, the seller is taking full advantage of Amazon's policy and is selling sub-standard product and getting away with it! This is fraudulent misrepresentation! BEWARE

I was hesitant to order these at first because of mixed reviews, but I’m glad I did!  I’m super happy about the variety of colors that I received; no two alike. I also already owned about 10 colors and assumed I would get duplicates of some I already owned, but nope! All of these colors are new to me! reviews.t: This was so disappointing! It made me so sad to get this.
reviews.x: 8 of my colors were some shade of pink! It wasn't even random, this COULD NOT BE RANDOM. For one color of pink, I got THREE OF THEM. The saddest part is I'm not a fan of pink 😭😭😭  I love the Sally Hansen miracle gel in general (great nail polish and applicator) but this whole experience made me want to cry. I paid $20 to be so disappointed. I don't even know what I'm going to be doing with these. Technically, I liked 1 out 10 colors (the mint). So I will give this 1/5 stars, will never purchase

reviews.t: Buyer Beware - Multiple duplicates in single collection order
reviews.x: This review is for the seller not the product. I love the Sally Hansen Miracle Gel line. I ordered the 10 piece random collection because it was a good deal and I thought it would be fun to get some random colors.  I did read the description prior to purchasing which states - if you order more than 1 set there is a high chance  of  duplicates being included in the 2nd set.  Silly me assumed that I only ordered the one set so I would get 10 different colors but that was not the case.  In my order

Is this the message they want to send to loyal customers or new customers like me, who will balk at buying more products? reviews.t: Meh, just go to the store and buy your polish
reviews.x: So the 2 stars is merely for the selection in which I recieved I love this nail polish.  But when I knowingly purchased the 10 random colors I 1.) Assumed that I would be receiving10 colors from the picture listed (all of which I like). 2.) Thought that I wouldn't get duplicate colors or multiple bottles of the same color... Wrong and wrong.  I got SEVERAL bottles of the brightest orange shade you can possibly imagine!  As if 1 bottle wasn't enough they gave me a lifetime supply of electric ass

They arrived undamaged. However, like most of the reviews, you do get similar colors and they are all the discontinued colors bought out when other retailers discontinued selling. I got three of the same shade and the trick was the number changed for the color but not the actual name of the color. I opened all the bottles, the brushes are all intact. I can tell the polish is old based on the consistency, and as mentioned before they are the discontinued colors. Some a few years old. Not worth th

[[VIDEOID:940cdfb6e7cde3754b6bcd9094f12be7]] I LOVE Sally Hansen Miracle Gel polish. Prior to ordering the set of 10, I already owned 6. I use them almost exclusively since they’re so great! I’m a little disappointed in the set I got from Amazon, though. Two of the10 polishes were faulty. One had crazy polish that dried suuuuper weird and the other had all the bristles fall out of the brush inside the bottle.  I’d love to give this product 5 stars, and will if the company sends me some replaceme

Completely obsessed with this and will most likely order again. This is the only nail polish that lasts me a week or longer. Every other one only lasts about 20 minutes and then it’s chipped. The only problem is I don’t want to spend 10 bucks a bottle. This solved that problem! I got 10 beautiful colors for the price of two!!! I knew it would be a gamble, but man I lucked out!! I will wear all 10 colors that came!

I ordered the 10 pack knowing it would be a risk. But for the price of this bulk order vs the regular cost of this brand of nail polish, I figured it was worth a gamble. I did receive 10 different shades, although a few are similar. Every bottle has it's brush, unlike some of the other reviews I read before buying. Nothing was broken, packaging was good, and shipping was fairly quick. Great deal, but with a risk.

Okay so let’s start with the positive it’s a great price for 6 or 10 bottles of the miracle gel nail polish.  However, in my box there were 7 of the same colors! One color very similar to the 7 bottles of pink and then a random blue and purple. And it was not wrapped properly. Like most people have stated there is no return policy.  So beware before purchasing.

I contacted the seller to request a Step 2 in my order. Seller was responsive. When order arrived, there was one duplicate color, but it's one I like. One bottle came with a broken brush and I didn't get a Step 2 with my order. I contacted Seller who is shipping both a Step 2 and replacement for the bottle with the broken brush.  Happy with this purchase.

I ordered the random collection and received 4 similar gold polishes, 2 of the same peach colored polishes, 2 similar nude color polishes and 2 top coats. What a disappointment. I thought there would be more of a variety of colors in the random collection. I basically got 3 colors. I would recommend you just select the colors you want.

reviews.t: TOO MANY OF THE SAME COLOR SHADES
reviews.x: The nail polish works great, but who would expect to receive a ten-piece random collection of colors, and half of them are the same color shades. Also, they need to change the picture because it shows a 20 piece color set, but it's only a set of 10. IT'S A FALSE ADVERTISEMENT! I will never order from them again.

reviews.t: Great value, disappointed in selection. Didn’t believe I would be sent duplicate colors ):
reviews.x: I love this nail polish! It is a heck of a deal for the quantity. Only disappointed in the colors that were selected 2 sets were duplicates, and 2 more sets were very similar is color. So instead of 10 different colors I was selected 6 colors instead of 10, if that makes sense.

I LOVE this omg. I just got them they’re all in great condition and such a good price for them. It’s my favorite nail polish. I immediately ordered another set. So happy with it. They were packed in bubble wrap I took it out to take the picture so you could see the colors

Ordered 10 pack. Got 9. 4 of the same pink. 4 of the same red. And one blue. Great variety. Tried to return and it’s not a returnable item!!! Had to call Amazon and go through that hassle to get a refund. Now I’ll have red and pink nail polish for the rest of my life.

Dont buy this product its not gel you cannot use with your uv lamp <thats the point why i bought this bundle>and when they say they will send you variety be prepared to receive 4 of the same color multiple times#so annoyed

reviews.t: It was a waste of money due to false advertisement
reviews.x: I was sent 6 bottles of the same colors and 4 smaller bottles (sample sizes) of a different brand. One of the bottles was opened and spilled all over the other bottles, so I threw all 10 bottles in the trash
Do not buy this , repeat colors and they put step 2 gel finish colors in they are not advertised or I would not purchased the set just to say it was 10 bottles . Do not buy !!!!

reviews.t: The package came with broken and smudged nailpolish bottles
reviews.x: One bottle was broken and all the other bottles were smudged with the nailpolish from broken bottle  I should have looked at other reviews. Lot of people experienced the same.
The product is so thick it makes me wonder if this is a fake product.  I brought one from a store and it wasn't as thick.  I'm also really unhappy I can not return these.
Got two of almost everything. A bottle was busted and another had leaked and seemed like it had been old polish that had been sitting on a shelf for a long time.

claims.text: Many buyers received multiple duplicate or near-identical shades instead of a varied random assortment, often several bottles of the same pink, peach, or orange color.
Some customers were pleased with the variety, receiving all or mostly different colors with no duplicates.
The price for a 10-pack of Miracle Gel polish is widely considered a great deal compared to buying bottles individually.
Several reviewers reported quality problems such as broken brushes, faulty or defective bottles, or polish that appeared opened or thinned.
Some buyers felt the colors received were discontinued or old stock rather than a genuinely random selection.
